title: Shear Elegance | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Pool and Large Outdoor Space Steps From Beach Access- Shear Elegance By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Shear Elegance by Royal Destinations Location: Blue Mountain Beach Address: 337 Blue Mountain Rd, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Searching for a 30A vacation rental that is located just steps from the beach access, has a large private pool, and an outdoor entertainment area? Look no further than Shear Elegance! This Blue Mountain vacation rental offers guests the ability to enjoy as much fun in the sun as possible. Guests of Shear Elegance can spend long days at the beach access (located just 100 feet away) and afterwards enjoy the backyard oasis by taking a refreshing dip in the private pool. Those searching for 30A vacation rentals with a private pool will not be disappointed as this home is 14’ x 28’ and can be heated for an additional cost. With the space to accommodate up to 20 people, this luxury 30A rental is perfect for extended family or multiple families traveling together. Boasting 3 living rooms, 6 bedrooms, 5 full baths, and 1 half bath, guests have plenty of space to gather together but also have the option to retreat to their own rooms surrounded by coastal elegant decor by Urban Grace interior designs. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 100 Feet (1 Minute Walk) -Parking Spaces: 5 Spaces in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 12, Bar Seating for 6 -Washer/Dryer Coffee Maker Available -Gas Grill Available (Propane Provided) -Private Heated Pool: 14’ x 28’ *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *The jetted spa, isn't a hot tub. If pool is heated, the jetted spa will be the same temperature. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: 6 Bedrooms / 5.5 Bathrooms / Sleeps 20 First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 2: Queen/King Bunk with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3: Two Queen/Queen Bunks with Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Two Living Areas -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 6 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Half Bath -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *The outdoor fire pit is not operational or available for guest use. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
